shared_elements: carved upright stone slab/pillar with relief decoration
low-relief incised motif on a vertical stone face
animal/zoomorphic imagery (creature heads in A's glyph blocks; arched serpentine creature in B)
justification: Both depict low-relief carving on an upright stone slab, and both include creature imagery, but A shows dense rows of rectangular composite glyph blocks packed edge-to-edge in framed columns, while B shows a single sparse arched serpentine animal with angular zigzag limbs isolated on an empty field. The organizing principle (gridded repeated sign blocks versus one large free-standing outline figure) and the drawing conventions (crowded, deeply modelled, ornate versus thin, schematic, linear) differ fundamentally.
